featured_reviews.name: raju mange
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bhanushali Banquets is easily one of the best venues in Mumbai. They have multiple banquet halls catering to all types of functions – marriage, sangeet, birthday, conferences, mata ki chowki, or any religious event.

They can host anywhere from 300 to 1000 guests across multiple floors, and the grand lobby makes for a great first impression. The staff is very courteous, and the entire place is kept spotlessly clean.

Infrastructure is top-notch: multiple elevators, escalators, dedicated freight elevators, and separate elevators for staff so guest movement is never disrupted. Ample basement parking and genset backup ensure zero hassle.

Their USP has to be the centralised AC – even during peak hours with a packed house, the cooling stays consistent. Acoustics are also very well done; no echo or sound reflection, so music and speeches sound clear and balanced.

If you want a premium, well-managed venue with great facilities, Bhanushali Banquets should be your first choice in Mumbai for any event.

featured_reviews.name: sanjay gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Vishal Hall Banquet Team,
I would like to share my feedback regarding the recent event we hosted at your venue.
Firstly, I truly appreciated the food quality, which was excellent, and the cleanliness, which was well-maintained throughout the event.
My ratings are as follows:
Food: 10/10
Service: 9/10 (slightly slow at times)
I would also like to appreciate the management person Akshay for his guidance throughout the process. Additionally, Mr. Abhishek and Mr. Naren did a commendable job in managing the food arrangements, and I sincerely thank them for their efforts.

However, I was extremely disappointed with the decor arrangements, which did not match the commitments made during booking. I genuinely felt that the amount paid for decor did not justify the final outcome. Here are the specific issues:
1. The decor was supposed to be fully ready by 5 PM so I could review everything and ensure it was up to the mark. However, the setup was only completed around 6 PM, by which time I was already occupied with other arrangements. This left no opportunity for a proper final check or to request timely corrections.
2. Old soft toys were used in the decor. They were so worn-out that I had to request their removal—and no replacement was provided.
3. The magic show & puppet show, which were clearly discussed and included in the deal, were changed without any prior information or approval. They were replaced with a “mind show,” which was never agreed upon.
4. The car provided was completely different from what was promised. We had booked a white, new Maybach, but what arrived was an old, damaged white car with a broken safety belt. This was highly unprofessional.
Overall, I would rate the Decor: POOR, and I genuinely felt betrayed by the lack of transparency and failure to deliver what was promised.

I would like to know who is responsible for these shortcomings and request appropriate compensation for the inconvenience and for not delivering the committed services.
I hope you will address this matter seriously and respond at the earliest.
Regards,
Sanjay Gupta

featured_reviews.name: Blesse
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience overall. Initially, the manager/owner spoke very politely and promised a “very good experience.” Everything was agreed upon smoothly at the beginning. However, once he realised we were about to finalise the booking, his attitude slowly started to change.

On the main event day, we were clearly cheated on the food arrangements.

We had finalised 2 veg and 2 non-veg starters. The Chicken Crispy was the worst I have ever had—very low-grade quality with extremely tiny pieces. Most of my guests did not receive the Malai Chicken Kebab, as it was not served to everyone.

We had also booked veg cheese balls, but they were not served at all. It felt like they took advantage of the fact that the hosts and families would be busy and quietly withheld certain items.

The most shocking part was that when food was finally served to me and my wife (the hosts), all four starters were served to us. That is when my family informed me that some of these items had never been served to many guests.

To be fair, the service staff and other team members were polite and supportive, and the general service flow was good. The issue lies clearly with management and food quality, not the staff on the floor.

The poor food quality and lack of transparency made the situation extremely embarrassing in front of guests.
I would not recommend this place, especially if you value honesty and consistency in what is promised versus what is delivered.

We had booked the hall at Shubham Banquets for our wedding day, expecting professionalism and basic courtesy on such an important occasion. However, our experience was extremely disappointing and unacceptable.

Shockingly, just one month before the wedding, we were informed that we would be required to vacate the hall by 2:30 PM, as the owner, Mr. Ravi, had his own relative’s wedding at the same venue in the evening. This was despite the fact that extensions are typically available at additional cost — an option that was not even offered to us.

On the wedding day, the situation worsened significantly. From around 1:00 PM, Mr. Ravi began interrupting our wedding rituals, creating unnecessary stress and disruption during what should have been a smooth and joyful ceremony. At exactly 2:30 PM, as we were preparing to wrap up, he entered the hall and started shouting at us in front of all our guests, demanding that we vacate immediately. This behavior was not only highly unprofessional but also deeply humiliating.

This kind of conduct is completely unacceptable, especially on an occasion as significant as a wedding. It showed a complete lack of respect, empathy, and basic customer service.

Our special day was tarnished by this experience. We strongly advise others to reconsider before booking Shubham Banquets.

featured_reviews.name: Yogesh Mumbai Local Guide
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are looking for a venue that balances budget and elegance in the eastern suburbs, City Banquet is a solid contender! 🏙️

**The Vibe & Decor** ✨
The hall has a very modern and clean aesthetic. The lighting is bright and festive, making it perfect for weddings, sangeets, or big birthday bashes. They have a spacious layout that doesn’t feel cramped even with a decent crowd. 💡🎊

**The Food** 🍲
The catering is one of the highlights! 🥘 Whether you're going for the Veg or Non-Veg spread, the flavors are authentic and the variety is impressive. The starters are usually a hit with the guests! 😋🍗

**Location & Accessibility** 📍
Located right on the **Ghatkopar-Mankhurd Link Road**, it is super easy for guests to find. It’s well-connected to both the Eastern Express Highway and the Navi Mumbai side. 🚗🛣️

**Pros:**

* **Ample Parking:** Unlike many Mumbai venues, they actually have decent space for vehicles. 🅿️✅.

* **Friendly Staff:** The management is cooperative and helps with the minute-to-minute flow of the event. 🤝

* **Great AC:** Keeping the Mumbai heat out is a priority, and their cooling system does the job well! ❄️💨

**Cons:**

* **Basement Access:** Note that the hall is in the basement, and the lack of an elevator can be a bit tricky for elderly guests. 🪜⚠️

* **Peak Hour Traffic:** Since it's on a main link road, traffic during evening muhrats can be a bit of a nightmare. 🚦😫

**Final Verdict:** A fantastic "value-for-money" venue for mid-sized gatherings (up to 400-450 people). It looks premium without the premium price tag! 💰💎

**Would I recommend it?** Yes! Just make sure to assist any elderly guests with the stairs. 👍🙌

Several promised arrangements were either delayed or not delivered at all.

The air conditioning was inconsistent, guests had to repeatedly ask for basic assistance, and overall event management was chaotic. There was no sense of accountability from the management team. Even simple requests were treated as inconveniences.

For the amount charged, the quality of service was unacceptable. A wedding is a once-in-a-lifetime event, and this venue failed to deliver even basic standards of hospitality and professionalism.

I would strongly advise future couples to think carefully before booking this hall. Based on our experience, it caused unnecessary stress on what should have been a joyful occasion.
